verdict.rationale: Buzz offers building blocks that could be used to give an outsider scoped access: private rooms, open/private channel visibility, per-identity channel memberships, explicit member enrollment via add-member, and an optional relay pubkey allowlist. Nothing in the evidence describes a guest account type, a restricted external-partner role, or channels shared across organizations or workspaces. Missing for 10: a documented guest/limited-access account type, shared or cross-organization channels, admin controls restricting guests to specific channels, and any hands-on corroboration of external-partner collaboration.
